description: This file defines classes for handling keyboard configuration commands in a kickstart installation script, including support for different versions and parsing command-line arguments.

classes.name: FC3_Keyboard
classes.description: Represents a keyboard configuration command for Fedora Core 3, allowing setting of keyboard type.

classes.name: F18_Keyboard
classes.description: Extends FC3_Keyboard to support additional keyboard layout options for Fedora 18, including VConsole and X layouts.

methods.name: FC3_Keyboard.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the FC3_Keyboard object, setting up the parser and keyboard attribute.

methods.name: FC3_Keyboard.__str__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the keyboard command, including the system keyboard if set.

methods.name: FC3_Keyboard._getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an argument parser for the keyboard command.

methods.name: FC3_Keyboard.parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set the keyboard configuration.

methods.name: F18_Keyboard.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the F18_Keyboard object, extending FC3_Keyboard with additional layout options.

methods.name: F18_Keyboard.__str__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the keyboard command, supporting multiple formats and layouts.

methods.name: F18_Keyboard._getArgsAsStr
methods.description: Constructs a string of command-line arguments for the various layout options.

methods.name: F18_Keyboard._getParser
methods.description: Extends the base parser with additional arguments for VConsole and X layouts.

methods.name: F18_Keyboard.parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, handling validation and setting internal attributes.

methods.name: F18_Keyboard.keyboard
methods.description: Property getter for the keyboard attribute, considering layout options.

methods.name: F18_Keyboard.keyboard (setter)
methods.description: Property setter for the keyboard attribute.
